title: Try a Triathlon for Women
description: Join the Sligo Triathlon Club's Try a Triathlon initiative for women aged 35 and older. No experience necessary, just a willingness to show up and learn. The 6-week training program starts next Sunday, and the actual triathlon event is on September 27th.
goals: Learn the basics of triathlon training
Build confidence and skills in swimming, cycling, and running
Prepare for a triathlon event on September 27th
